items.title: Analysis & objectives
items.text: We start with a real conversation: your business, your clients, what is stuck today. No ready-made solution — I first look for where time and leads are being lost.

items.title: Build plan
items.text: I draw the full journey: who uses the tool, what they see, what triggers action. Every screen and every automation has a precise role.

items.title: Tool & integrations
items.text: I build the tool and connect it to what exists: calendar, form, CRM, database. A clean, fast system you can evolve without depending on anyone.

items.title: AI & follow-ups
items.text: Everything that can be automated is: follow-ups, summaries, triage, confirmations. You answer within 24h even when swamped.

items.title: Measure & optimise
items.text: Launch, test, measure. We look at the numbers together, adjust what needs adjusting, and the tool improves month after month.

about.intro: Who I am, what I do,
paragraphs: My name is Benjamin de Bruijne. I live in Belgium, near Brussels, and I have worked in IT for over twenty years — over 200 web projects built or delivered: development, project management, product, quality, digital transformation.

I have led projects in highly regulated environments (pharmaceutical industry) and built, in parallel, my own products: Service-Volée, Pulse Noir and BiblioPulse (a 2,150-reader crime-fiction community and its library), and an ecosystem around control of data: Beneloo (SME visibility in AI engines), the Observatory (the measurement, sector by sector) and Singulr, the non-profit I chair, which operates sovereign digital commons including a Git forge hosted in Belgium.

That double track is my edge: the rigour of a large group, the speed of a freelancer. I can scope, document and deliver by the book, and I can also code a complete tool in a few days when that is what is needed.
I work through my company, Hakuna Matata SRL, and I pick tools that leave you in control: code you own, data at home, no opaque subscriptions.
